name: Mika Tsai
life: “I still remember the first visit wearing my own coat after discharge.” People around Breakwater Way know Mika by a small Friday habit. Mika stops on the landward side of the cycle track to watch the first boats turn for home.
voice: I was discharged that morning and returned as a visitor in my own coat. It was my favorite birthday present to either of them.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a charcoal zip cardigan and a comb in a sleeve sewn into the lining. Mika has fine brows over wide-set eyes, with black hair twisted into a small knot. Mika counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices during a conversation.
personality: Mika can be lavish with time and quite careful with cash. A free afternoon is sometimes the biggest gift Mika can afford to give, and family knows to take it seriously.
agenda: To visit the ward in an ordinary coat.
family: Lars Tang is Mika’s older cousin. Mika gets to change the plan. Lars offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *An old restaurant debt*, Lars says, “I carved the ham years ago. Now my hands shake and the owner's son asked me to teach him where to start.”
connections: Bailey Alston. A divided banner leaves the newly discharged visitor enough space to add a personal message.

reactions.situation: The other requests the biggest balloon anyone can find
reactions.response: Mika finds out where the big balloon can go without crowding anyone else's bed.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Mika asks the stranger who will be expecting them, then helps find a way to tell that person.
